beaches.name: Salanti (Saladi Beach)
beaches.summary: Greece's first naturist hotel opened on this beach in 1980. Press retellings from 2021 and 2025 document the nudist-only hotel, the expulsion of its guests by villagers by boat the same year, and the now-derelict building slated for redevelopment; no current dress-code reports are documented.

beaches.name: Kantia
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported right of the beach access, west of Kantia village. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2018 and 2019 with several nude couples on a 200 m section, and an August 2020 visit when the couple were the only ones nude. No designation is documented.
